items.title: PHP ships emergency RCE patches
items.oneliner: PHP patched two unauthenticated RCEs across 8.2 to 8.5. If you run mod_php, patch before your app boots.

items.title: OpenAI models land on Google Cloud
items.oneliner: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud, turning frontier models into a multi-cloud procurement decision, not a platform lock-in.

items.title: OpenAI pushes harder into biology
items.oneliner: OpenAI says thousands of agents analyzed millions of mouse brain cells in 32 minutes, compressing months of biological reasoning.

items.title: Anthropic pushes a federal AI bill
items.oneliner: Anthropic wants federal rules that could block model releases if misuse might kill 50 people. Safety policy is getting operational.

items.title: Mozilla moved fast on eMudhra compromise
items.oneliner: Mozilla blocked eight compromised eMudhra intermediates within hours. Browser trust still hinges on a few brittle certificate authorities.

items.title: Meta Muse leaked shared chats
items.oneliner: Meta paused Muse chat sharing after researchers found exposed links and 6,800 share addresses. AI UX keeps creating privacy incidents.

items.title: LiteLLM package was backdoored on PyPI
items.oneliner: LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI shipped a credential stealer and backdoor. Your AI stack is only as safe as pip install.

items.title: PingCAP disclosed a cloud data breach
items.oneliner: PingCAP says stolen service credentials exposed source code and customer data for nearly a month. Secrets management failed first.

items.title: DuckDB 2.0 becomes the LTS line
items.oneliner: DuckDB 2.0 LTS adds async I/O, VARIANT, triggers, and agent mode. Embedded analytics keeps absorbing warehouse workloads.

items.title: Trail of Bits ships agent patching tools
items.oneliner: Trail of Bits released plugins for agent-written patches and regression hunts. The real bottleneck is now verification, not code generation.
